newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine union leader Daer released from hospital.
newsitem.headline: Argentine union leader Daer released from hospital.

text.p: Argentina's top union leader Rodolfo Daer was discharged from a Buenos Aires hospital Thursday after spending the night under observation following a mild heart problem, the state-run Telam news agency reported.
The leader of the CGT labor federation told reporters he felt better after leaving hospital, Telam said.

Local television had shown the 44-year old leader of Argentina's main labor federation CGT clutching his head and sitting down on Wednesday before a union meeting to discuss a government offer to negotiate on labor reforms.
The meeting was postponed until next Tuesday.
A member of the governing Peronist Party, who like other top CGT leaders was long close to President Carlos Menem, Daer nonetheless led two general strikes in September and December.
